## Checklist

- [ ] The linked issue existed before I opened this PR.
- [ ] The PR title and authored commits follow Conventional Commits.
- [ ] The diff is focused and acceptance criteria are covered.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed, or skipped checks are explained above.
- [ ] Documentation and tests are updated where behavior changed.
- [ ] No secrets, production state, private notes, or unsanitized captures are included.
- [ ] Breaking changes and security/privacy/operational impact are documented.
- [ ] This is ready for maintainer review, or marked as a draft.
